units.spine: The City Council at Rundgate governs with a modest edge in its favour, its requests granted more often than not, with exceptions few enough to be named.
Rundgate credits the City Council with the good years whether or not it earned them, and the prosperity is the whole of the argument in its favour.
What is settled at Rundgate is the hall and only the hall, and the town's steadiness is a statement about who answers, not about what the answers will be.
Nobody at Rundgate needs the trouble explained to them, since it is recent enough that the town simply refers to it and moves on.
A criminal operation at Rundgate carries local weight, territorial or economic, and no clearer description of it exists than that.
The hall at Rundgate is not organised into sides. The factions sit as factions, and nothing binds any two of them into anything larger.
The City Council at Rundgate watches for the town's own temper, knowing that a council falls to unrest rather than to a rival.

units.poolKey: governing body name: a SLOT, never a baked noun
units.spine: A stranger who addresses the City Council at Rundgate by any other title is corrected, politely and immediately.
The City Council outweighs everyone at Rundgate who wants its seat, and though the wanting is on the record, the hold is real and not comfortable.

units.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public backing hardens the hold
units.spine: Public backing at Rundgate is hardening the City Council's grip, and what would be a contest elsewhere is an inconvenience here.
